entityDescription: My main drive is to inspire people as an artist and as a gallerist in the perspective of collaboration with galleries in New york, L.A. and Paris for my artists and me, with the help of the newest technologies and blockchain. NORAVISION, is a decentralized ecosystem through which an eclectic pool of artists, collectors, investors, auction houses, and galleries gather in efforts to raise awareness of the world’s most talented artists through liquidable digital-asset investments, an AIpowered digital community, and blockchain-driven authenticity & tracking protocols. The mission of the NORAVISION platform is to create further transparency in efforts to demotivate the art black market, whilst offering higher transactionatory speeds, within a fully-traceable art world. At the core, functional level, the NORAVISION ecosystem leverages “eDLT” technology, of which boasts a custom Blockchain protocol. In efforts to decentralize the art world, each member of the NORAVISION ecosystem acts as a “node” which has the capacity to engage in smart-contract based transactions and data sharing that is traced from the artists, to the end-clients. In the position of acting as a “node,” each ecosystem member has - due to the decentralized manner of the NORAVISION ecosystem, the complete right of privacy over their data and personal information sharing, of which is especially important when protecting the privacy of the entire ecosystem. With each node acting as an active member of NORAVISION, the eDLT-powered platform allows for a true peer-to-peer experience through offering each member AI-driven curation via an intuitive e-boutique; authenticate and physically track art on different scales with the latest IoT (Internet of Things) hardware; whilst allowing for artists to “tokenize” their businesses, and raise funds from their audience base in a seamless, highly-liquidable fashion. Via the NORAVISION ecosystem’s fundraising model, we were able to create the world’s first example of tokenizing artists themselves through which he/she is able to share gross revenues with his/her investor community via a Digital Security Offering (otherwise known as a Security Token Offering - STO) NORAVISION will be a cornerstone in the art world, and all of its inner-workings, as the main element of our “why” is fueled by personal pain points stemming from our Founder’s experience as an artist herself. NORAVISION was built for the international Art community, by members of the international Art community. NORAVISIONSOLAR - CREATIVE & CIRCULAR, SOLAR PANELS as Work of Art, sold on Auctions or metro - airport murals, profit goes to Artists and Trustees delegated for recyclation of old panels...The prolonged lifetime of the panel itself allows dignified hold and creates a positive economic model that indirectly takes care of the fate of old panels, while also creating recyclables and creating unique added value. This model uses the ready - made concept, recorded in the historical course of time. Picture of the Diptych Solar Queen uses the principle of creative recycling, leaving a visible solar network, which is only slightly indicated in the impressionist Sunset. The works were created in cooperation with the director of Suncontract, Mr.Gregor Novak and with BISOL solar company. Recent projects including paited solar panels were: Contemporary Venice, 2019, Luce Dell eterno, Glass Cathedral Santa Chiara, Murano, 2020, Artes Dei, Festival Ljubljana, 2020, Metamorphoses - The Worlds of Change, 2021, Ministry of Culture, Republic of Slovenia.

entityDescription:
The Composite & Smart Materials Laboratory (CSML) was established in 2007, as part of the Mechanics and NDE Division of the Department of Materials Science and Engineering (DMSE), University of Ioannina.

The mission of the CSML is to provide education and research in the field of Advanced Composite Materials and Structures with special emphasis in Non-Destructive Evaluation and Multiple Smart Functionalities. In the area of destructive evaluation emphasis is given in the durability of composite materials (wear behavior, mechanical / thermomechanical characterization, environmental loading, fracture and fatigue). Research activities include hierarchical Composites and interfaces, biodegradable micro/nano-composites: manufacturing and processing, smart multifunctional materials and structures, and novel NDE and process monitoring technique development based on Thermal, Optical and Electrical stimulation/ response of the interrogated structures.
Since its foundation, CSML features more than 150 journal and conference publications, cited more than 2400 times, a significant number of national and international collaborations, the hosting of the “Emerging Technologies in Non-Destructive Testing” international conference and the organization of the summer school on "Composite and Smart Materials: Theory and Applications" in collaboration with the Aristotle University of Thessaloniki and Texas A& M University. CSML has attracted approximately M�2 funding, almost in total (>97%) from competitive research programs and private collaborations.
The academic members of CSML are responsible for the teaching (or co-teaching) of 10 theoretical and laboratory undergraduate courses in the DMSE curriculum and 4 courses in the recently established postgraduate course of DMSE, “Advanced Materials”. In CSML, more than 15 postgraduate students (MSc or PhD) work in a variety of research projects and more than 20 undergraduate students perform their final year project.

entityDescription:
QED Software is a research and development company focused on creating new mathematical methods and their application in production environments. Our focus lies in data analysis, data exploration, machine learning and approximated reasoning / artificial intelligence. We have years of experience with computer vision, time series analysis and forecasts, exploratory data analysis, as well as analysis of heterogonous data. Implementations include large scale image processing, predictive maintenance, time series forecasts, modelling and prediction of environmental hazards, text and data mining, as well as secure processing of image streams combined with non-image data sources. 

Research work is supervised by academic staff: prof. Dominik Slezak, prof. Bogusław Cyganek, prof. Marek Sikora. 

Research topics: 
Computer vision - segmentation, classification and extracting features from images combined with non-image data sources. Utilization of these methods on large and quickly-increasing data sets. Building services on satellite data. We cooperate closely with CloudFerro as manager of CREODIAS platform. 
Scaling of ML on big data sets - pairing custom compression methods with ML methods that can be used on compressed data. As a result, machine learning models can be executed much faster than on the original data, without big loss of output accuracy. These methods can be used both on time series data, and on images / video sources. These methods can be used for edge processing - where its not feasible to transfer data to data center for full processing - or as a tool for quick approximated scans of big data sets. 
Explainability of ML - our research focuses on introduction of explainability overlay to existing and new machine learning models, aimed at explaining reasoning behind system output, impact of data quality on model errors and giving insight into sources of uncertainty of model outputs. The toolset can be used both by end users, to enrich model output, and by engineers to optimize model operation during its creation/modifications. 
Support for active learning - optimization of active learning cycles by choosing optimal data for labelling and using it to retrain / upgrade ML model output quality. Using this approach, it is possible to begin with a machine learning model, and upkeep / increase its output quality by picking minimal set of data points that, when used to retrain the model, has maximum output in terms of model quality. These set of tools and techniques can be used to maintain model quality for models operating in changing and unstable environments. 
Steering of agents in simulation environment - a technology primarily developed for game development studios, it can find its use in any multi-agent simulation environment, where there's need for algorithmic and evolutionary behavior of agents, especially if said agents need to perform in a certain way (e.g. human-like behavior). 
Automatic coaching - a system allowing for automated coaching and insights to humans, in any situation where tasks are well measured and when a goal function can be defined / observed. Adding a layer of human-language ontology, it is possible to give feedback regarding what can be done in order to perform these tasks better. Possible usage includes high-value specialized equipment operators or high risk human operations - both within VR training facilities and in a real world use scenarios. 

Before 2020, the company operated as a central hub for daughter companies, each focusing on different aspect of machine learning and AI applications. 
In 2020, we're moving people and projects into QED Software, forming a uniform R&D team of 40 employees till the end of the year.
